'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces]] gunmen shoot and kill a [[British people|British]] and [[South Africans|South African]] [[honeymoon]] couple and their local [[tour guide]] at the [[Queen Elizabeth National Park]] in [[Western Region, Uganda|Western]] [[Uganda]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-67142166 (BBC News)]
*[[Gaza-Israel conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
****[[Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war]]
*****[[Saudi Arabia]] tells its citizens to immediately leave [[Lebanon]] due to the deteriorating security situation in the [[southern Lebanon|south of the country]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/18/Saudi-Arabia-calls-on-citizens-to-immediately-leave-Lebanon (Al Arabiya)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[United States]] [[United Nations Security Council veto power|vetoes]] a [[United Nations Security Council]] resolution that would have condemned violence against civilians while urging [[humanitarian]] aid to [[Palestinians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Twelve countries vote in favour of the resolution, while [[Russia]] and the [[United Kingdom]] abstain. [https://apnews.com/article/un-security-council-resolution-gaza-hamas-1c23913f8552f5379b2c158a83493835 (AP)]
****[[United Nations]] experts, including [[Pedro Arrojo-Agudo]], express serious concerns over Israel tightening its siege on Gaza, saying it "is an ongoing campaign resulting in [[crimes against humanity]].” [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/un-rights-experts-warn-israels-actions-in-gaza-resulting-in-crimes-against-humanity/3027852 (Anadolu)]
****[[Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator|UN Under-Secretary-General]] [[Martin Griffiths]] reiterates that there are [[Law of war|rules of war]] after the US vetoed the resolution. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/17/israel-hamas-war-live-anger-after-israeli-strike-kills-500-in-hospital (Al Jazeera)] [https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/mr-martin-griffiths-under-secretary-general-humanitarian-affairs-and-emergency-relief-coordinator-security-council-briefing-situation-middle-east-including-palestinian-question (Relief Web)]
****[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] condemns the UNSC for failing to pass a resolution for a humanitarian pause, adding that efforts to deescalate the conflict have been impeded by the [[collective punishment]] of [[Palestinians]] through [[airstrike]]s and the deployment of [[United States Armed Forces|US]] [[aircraft carrier]]s to the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/turkeys-erdogan-un-security-council-has-not-fulfilled-responsibility-gaza-2023-10-18 (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] strikes across [[Ukraine]], kill at least 10 people, including five [[civilian]]s in a strike on an [[apartment|apartment building]] in [[Zaporizhzhia]], according to Ukrainian officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/civilian-killed-russias-attack-zaporizhzhia-ukraines-official-2023-10-18/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/18/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
***[[Russia]] says that the [[U.S.]] decision to supply Ukraine with long-range [[MGM-140 ATACMS|ATACMS]] [[tactical ballistic missile]]s is a "grave mistake" which will have serious consequences. [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] used the missiles in combat for the first time yesterday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-decision-send-long-range-missiles-kyiv-grave-mistake-russias-envoy-2023-10-18/ (Reuters)]
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Guinea-Bissau]]'s capital [[Bissau]] experiences a major [[power outage|blackout]] after [[Turkey|Turkish]] energy firm [[Karpowership]] suspends the supply of electricity to the city over an unpaid bill of at least [[US$]]15m. The [[Politics of Guinea-Bissau|Guinea-Bissauan government]] says that the outstanding amount will be paid within 15 days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-67143386 (BBC News)]
*[[Philippine President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] postpones the enactment of the [[Maharlika Investment Fund]], [[Philippines|the country]]'s proposed first [[sovereign wealth fund]], citing the need for further review. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/philippines-bongbong-marcos-suspends-implementation-soverign-wealth-fund-3854266 (Reuters via CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A driver is arrested after crashing into a group of [[Pepperdine University]] students walking in [[Malibu, California|Malibu]], [[California]], [[United States]], killing four and injuring two others. [https://apnews.com/article/malibu-4-killed-car-crash-ab620b3670f6146011fff8589956a05f (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Holy See–Nicaragua relations]]
**[[Nicaragua]] releases 12 [[Catholic Church|Catholic]] priests, critical of [[President of Nicaragua|President]] [[Daniel Ortega]]'s regime, and sends them to [[Rome]], [[Italy]], following an agreement with [[Vatican City]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/20/world/americas-emea/dozen-nicaraguan-priests-freed-sent-to-vatican/1915558 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Israel–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] visits [[Israel]] and meets with [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/18/joe-biden-urges-israel-not-be-consumed-by-rage-pledges-support-netanyahu-gaza-hamas (''The Guardian'')]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Department]] announces an ease of certain oil, gas, and gold [[Sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis|sanctions]] on [[Venezuela]] following the [[Government of Venezuela|Venezuelan government]] and [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]]'s agreement to conduct [[Elections in Venezuela|elections]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20231019-us-says-will-ease-venezuela-oil-gas-sanctions-after-election-deal (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Disappearance of Natalee Holloway]]
**Dutch [[serial killer]] [[Joran van der Sloot]] confesses in a U.S. federal court that he killed Natalee Holloway. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/10/18/us/joran-van-der-sloot-natalee-holloway-plea-wednesday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]], [[Antisemitism in 21st-century Germany]]
**[[Extremist]]s throw [[Molotov cocktail]]s at a [[synagogue]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. The incident is being investigated as a [[Terrorism in Germany|terrorist attack]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-chancellor-olaf-scholz-condemn-synagogue-attack-berlin/ (Politico)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[Anti-war movement|Anti-war]] activists gather at the [[Cannon House Office Building]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], calling for a [[ceasefire]]. Over 300 people are arrested following the protest. [https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/dozens-arrested-inside-cannon-house-office-building-after-rallying-for-israel-hamas-ceasefire/3447731/ (NBC 4 Washington)]
*The [[Palace of Versailles]] and three [[French airports]] are temporarily [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] "for security reasons". [https://apnews.com/article/france-airports-evacuated-threats-e8ecfbf5b2dc0b7f24d467db64374259 (AP)]
*[[Chad]]ian [[Government of Chad|Defense Minister]] [[Daoud Yaya Brahim]] and the government's general secretary are sacked after a [[sex tape]] is leaked showing the two men having sex with other people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/chads-defence-minister-government-general-secretary-resign-after-sex-tapes-2023-10-18/#:~:text=Prime%20Minister%20Saleh%20Kebzabo%20accepted,statement%2C%20without%20giving%20further%20details (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Indonesian presidential election]]
**Chairwoman of the ruling [[Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle]] [[Megawati Sukarnoputri]] announces that [[Coordinating Ministry for Political, Legal, and Security Affairs|Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal and Security Affairs]] [[Mahfud MD]] will be a vice-presidential running mate for [[Ganjar Pranowo]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-presidential-election-mahfud-ganjar-3854336 (CNA)]
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] majority fails to deliver enough votes for [[Jim Jordan]] to become [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] on the second vote [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/17/politics/jordan-speaker-vote-house-floor/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Parliament of Georgia|Georgian parliament]] members from the ruling [[Georgian Dream]] party fail to impeach [[President of Georgia|President]] [[Salome Zourabichvili]], securing only 86 of the required 100 votes, after the [[Constitutional Court of Georgia|constitutional court]] ruled that Zourabichvili violated the [[Constitution of Georgia (country)|constitution]] by advocating for [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]'s [[Potential enlargement of the European Union|European Union membership]] during [[List of international presidential trips made by Salome Zourabichvili|international trips]] without [[Government of Georgia (country)|government]] approval. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231018-georgia-ruling-party-fails-to-oust-pro-western-president (AFP via France 24)]
